title: inspectScenarios
responsibility: Reads working-tree scenario and unit manifests to list capture summaries, show one scenario’s requirements, or report contract and coverage problems.

inputs.name: listScenarios.root
inputs.description: Repository root whose working-tree scenario and unit manifests are read; a relative value is resolved against process.cwd() by path.resolve. It matters when the process is not running at the repository root, and it defaults to process.cwd() when omitted.

inputs.name: showScenario.id
inputs.description: Scenario id matched by strict equality against the id of each valid working-tree scenario manifest, with no trimming or case folding. A value with no match makes showScenario reject with ExpectedCliError.

inputs.name: showScenario.root
inputs.description: Repository root whose working-tree scenario and unit manifests are read; a relative value is resolved against process.cwd() by path.resolve. It matters when the process is not running at the repository root, and it defaults to process.cwd() when omitted.

inputs.name: checkScenarios.root
inputs.description: Repository root whose working-tree scenario and unit manifests are read; a relative value is resolved against process.cwd() by path.resolve. It matters when the process is not running at the repository root, and it defaults to process.cwd() when omitted.

outputs.name: listScenarios
outputs.type: Promise<Array<{ id: string; kind: ScenarioManifest['kind']; title: string; units: string[]; captures: number; unproven: number; excluded: number }>>
outputs.description: Each valid scenario manifest in the working tree, sorted by id with JavaScript string comparison, as its id, kind, title, and covered units, plus captures (the required capture count), unproven (states with missing coverage), and excluded (states with inapplicable coverage). Manifests that fail validation are omitted here, and their errors appear only in checkScenarios.

examples.title: Scenario listing from the working tree

outputs.name: showScenario
outputs.description: The validated scenario manifest under scenario, plus required (each capture a passing verification must contain, with its evidence, kind, state, and viewport when the evidence lists viewports), unproven (states with missing coverage), and excluded (states with inapplicable coverage). Each unproven or excluded row carries the state's reason, or an empty string when the manifest gives none.

excluded.reason: The grid has no print layout.

states.title: Print layout
states.reason: The grid has no print layout.

outputs.name: checkScenarios
outputs.type: Promise<{ scenarios: number; errors: string[]; health: ScenarioHealth }>
outputs.description: The scenarios field counts the valid scenario manifests, and errors lists the validation errors from reading them, followed by one "<scenario id> covers unknown unit <unit id>" message for each scenario unit that has no valid unit manifest. The health field is the report-only summary of viewport ids and sizes, state coverage, and active units that no scenario covers, and it is never added to errors.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown by fail() when no valid scenario manifest has the requested id, with the message Unknown scenario "<id>"; showScenario is async, so callers receive it as a rejected promise.
